Where each field of one record comes from

Item: Aeon — https://githits.com/software-factories/aeon/ → one line in data/listings.jsonl. The parser is deterministic BeautifulSoup over the cached HTML snapshot: no JavaScript execution, no embedded JSON dataset (the page's only JSON-LD is SEO boilerplate), no LLM. Numbers on the screenshots match the tables below.

fetch — one polite HTTP GET, response stored verbatim → snapshot — cache/html/…/aeon/index.html + meta.json → parse — BeautifulSoup, fixed CSS-selector mapping → record — listings.jsonl id aeon

regions 10–19The Details rows — every label/value pair

Rows are captured generically as {label, text, links[]} in document order — so labels the parser has never seen before are kept (flagged unrecognized_label), never dropped. Three row shapes get extra structure: Repository (repo list + stars), Topics (tag links), and any row with a <time datetime> element.

11sections.details.entries[] — "Company"dl.listing-details div:has(dt "Company")Aeonplain text row

What is deliberately not extracted

  • No JSON dataset exists on the page. The single application/ld+json block is schema.org SEO boilerplate (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, a thin WebPage node) — no features, details rows, license, repositories, stars or topics. Everything above comes from semantic HTML.
  • The JSON-LD dateModified duplicates the Last-verified date at page granularity; redundant with <time datetime>, so not extracted.
  • Outbound sites are never crawled — aeon.fun and github.com URLs are recorded as strings, not followed.
  • The on-page tab navigation (nav.listing-tabs: Overview/Features/Details/Similar anchors) is pure in-page navigation and skipped by design.
  • Star glyphs and checkmark SVGs are decorative markup; the counts and feature texts are what get captured.
  • Anything the parser does not understand (an unknown section, an unexpected element) would land in the record's fallback[] with its raw HTML — across all 239 live records this has never fired, because the site's markup is uniform.
